title: Correct current magnitude
description: Essential: The response must state the final numerical answer as 60000 A (or equivalent in scientific notation).

title: Current definition applied
description: Important: The response must correctly apply the formula I = Q/t to relate charge, time, and average current.

title: Correct unit usage
description: Important: The final answer must include the correct unit for current (Amperes, A).

title: Unit analysis shown
description: Optional: The response may show unit analysis (C/s = A) to verify the calculation.

title: Incorrect formula application
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect formula (e.g., I = Q*t) results in a wrong answer and should be penalized.

title: Calculation or unit error
description: Pitfall: Making an arithmetic error in the division (300/0.005) or omitting/fumbling the units is a common mistake.
